summary: YYForce Inc., a Singapore-domiciled foreign private issuer formerly YY Group Holding, furnished a Form 6-K attaching unaudited condensed consolidated interim financial statements, MD&A and a press release for the six months ended June 30, 2026. No transaction, tender, proxy contest, strategic review or corporate action is disclosed. It is a routine semi-annual earnings filing, incorporated by reference into the company's existing Form F-3 shelf registrations (File Nos. 333-286705 and 333-297406). No deal terms, board recommendation, advisor, or risk-arbitrage angle arise; monitor only for subsequent capital-markets activity off the shelf.
